meta.subject: Micah's 30th birthday wall
meta.status: PARTIAL RECOVERY — database deleted; 14 of 19 notes complete, 5 nearly complete but clipped at frame edges

sources.name: YouTube demo video
sources.title: Demoing a Replit app: Warm Fuzzy Birthday Wall
sources.detail: 163.8s screen recording, downloaded at 1280x720, sampled at 2fps -> 328 frames, 42 distinct views. Primary source.

sources.detail: 1280x720 frame of the wall, used for cross-checking.

sources.name: User-supplied screenshot

sources.name: Additional user-supplied video stills (1920x1080)
sources.detail: Two full-resolution 1080p stills of the demo video, larger and cleaner than the downloaded stream. Resolved signatures (Bryan, Quana - UTP3, NFT Daddy, JP, GG) and recovered the bodies of four previously fragmentary notes.

confidence_legend.high: Full text recovered and legible, cross-checked across sources
confidence_legend.medium: Most of the note recovered, but it opens or closes mid-sentence at a frame edge — beginning or ending genuinely lost

notes.author: Hope
notes.text: Happy Birthday Geo 🥳 You amazing, creative, technologically brilliant, phenomenal soul, you! Keep creating the music ever inspiring Humanity to sing. Wishing you 30 more extraordinary years ahead - and a thousand more greater still. - Hope 🎈 Well

notes.author: Crystal Gravy
notes.text: Yoooo Mr geo you're the man! Great to know ya. Happy birthday!

notes.author: Anonymous
notes.text: Happy birthday to the most creative and inspiring person I have ever met. A person with more drive and intelligence than most. Thank God for the parking meter we met at. May the next 30 years be even better than your last!

notes.author: TB
notes.text: You've always been so driven, curious, & experimental. Happy Birthday! Hope this new decade is grounded in community, awe, & safe places to land 🕊️

notes.author: JP
notes.text: I told chatgpt to catch me outside on righting an essay for Micah's 30th birthday. But I really didn't have a good joke to follow that up with. Umm. Yeah. What else do I say? This dude right here (metaphorically points at Micah), all grown and stuff in his 30s now. I love him. And don't you forget that. Happy Birthday!
notes.source: video frames + thumbnail (top of note cut off in early frames)
notes.recovery_note: Signature "JP" and the closing lines ("...that. Happy Birthday!") recovered.

notes.author: JD
notes.text: Eyyyy! Happy fu*cckkkiiinnng birthday!! It's been a pleasure to have met you and hoping the best for you man! Good luck on your journey and make those moments count!

notes.author: Allie
notes.text: MICAH!! So grateful to have met u. I literally wouldn't be where I am if it weren't for your kind heart. Love u boo!!

notes.author: Mani
notes.text: Micah!! We've known each other 16 years now!! Happy 30th 🥳🎂 As this benchmark hits, I hope you continue to bring your childhood curiosities and imaginative creativity to every endeavor you choose. Wishing many more revolutions for ya! Much prosperity, love, and positive energy 🫶🏼✨

notes.author: Sarang
notes.text: I met Micah way back in 2015 (10 years ago??) when we were proctors / student research assistants at the good ol' TACC Vislab at UT Austin. We collab'd on a bunch of cool projects on multi touch and immersive technologies and generally had good times. Over the summer I remember making a cool promo video for Google Glass research and Micah was the star actor and our buddy RJ made the background piano music. Happy birthday bro! Keep in touch 🚀

still_missing.reasoning: The video is a 2-minute demo, not an exhaustive capture. Notes that were never scrolled into view during the recording are unrecoverable from any known source. 18 notes were visible at some point; the original wall likely held more, given the video shows 'load more' behavior and pagination at 12 notes per page.
known_gaps: Any notes beyond what the demo happened to scroll past
exhausted_sources: Replit/Neon database — deleted, ~1 week retention, expired by months
Wayback Machine — zero snapshots of warmfuzzywall.replit.app or warm-fuzzy-wall.replit.app
Live deployment — API returns 500, database connection dead
Git history — no dumps, exports, or seed data ever committed

Check personal camera roll and Google Photos around Apr 23 - May 9, 2025
Check Downloads folder for a JSON export (the app had an Export button at /api/notes/export) — this would recover everything perfectly
Ask Sarang, Hope, Mani, Allie, JD, TB, Crystal Gravy — named authors can confirm their own note text and may have others
